tldr: How much can a fixed external causal case-mix effect move when two latent proxy channels drift slightly across three populations while all released proxy tables and randomized arm means remain exactly unchanged? The proposed result combines globally sharp finite endpoints, a target-specific local linear program, and separate inverse-signature and inverse-prevalence-rank sensitivity mechanisms. This matters because exact-invariance identification gives no quantitative guarantee under even small departures from measurement invariance.
gap: Exact-invariance latent calibration, robust factor recovery for perturbed product tensors, and fitted measurement non-equivalence results do not give the finite sharp diameter of this exact released three-population causal-target fiber under bounded latent channel drift. Entrywise bounded one-proxy causal partial identification and sharp local continuous measurement-error intervals are prior art in distinct information regimes.
